economic_rationale: CCI scales completed-day typical-price displacement from its rolling mean by mean absolute deviation. The mechanism is useful only if conventional positive/negative 100 hysteresis retains material upside after costs while reducing drawdown and improving Calmar with broad annual and adjacent 75/125-threshold support; normalized displacement alone is not alpha.
mechanism: For every complete UTC day, compute exact TA-Lib CCI14 from daily high, low and close. Starting in cash, enter fully long BTC when completed-day CCI is strictly above positive 100 and remain in the prior state until CCI is strictly below negative 100, when the strategy exits to zero-yield cash. State changes execute at the next H1 open. Symmetric 75 and 125 bands are frozen rejection-only neighbors.
thesis: When completed-day BTC typical price moves more than one conventional CCI unit band above its recent dispersion-adjusted mean, a causal next-open long state held until the symmetric negative extreme may retain directional upside while avoiding enough sustained adverse paths to improve fee-adjusted risk-adjusted performance over full-capital buy-and-hold.
title: Daily TA-Lib-default CCI14 symmetric-hysteresis long/cash timing
